unavailable_or_qualification: Single institution; Korean recruitment does not establish an ethnicity-specific effect.

source: Original clinical table and clinical workbook: Stage.1
definition_and_use: Supplied integer stage I–IV retained. Stage counts: I=6, II=26, III=50, IV=5.

definition_and_use: Raw TNM strings retained for audit. A separate sensitivity derives broad I–III groups from strictly interpretable M0 records.
unavailable_or_qualification: Missing or nonstandard components are not repaired. Derived groups are analytical alternatives, not adjudicated clinical stage.

definition_and_use: Patients with stage I–III disease: 82 patients and 14 recurrence or progression events.
unavailable_or_qualification: A TNM-derived group does not alter primary eligibility.

definition_and_use: Binary provider-recorded recurrence or progression; 17 events overall and 14 in the primary population.
unavailable_or_qualification: Local versus distant recurrence, diagnostic confirmation criteria and adjudication procedures were not supplied.
Predictor set contains measurements available at surgery; postoperative treatment and follow-up information are excluded.

source: Clinical workbook: Date of last follow-up; provider reply
definition_and_use: Provider confirmed that this field is recurrence date for patients with recurrence and last follow-up date otherwise. Duration is endpoint date minus operation date in days.
unavailable_or_qualification: This interpretation was confirmed by correspondence, not independently adjudicated against clinical charts.

definition_and_use: Death status and death date were not included.
unavailable_or_qualification: Overall survival, death-inclusive disease-free survival and competing-risk cumulative incidence cannot be derived.

definition_and_use: Raw ng/mL values take precedence over inconsistent historical binary labels. Elevation is >7 ng/mL: 18/87. Prediction uses log1p of the raw value.
unavailable_or_qualification: Provider confirmed the supplied reference threshold; laboratory assay and institutional derivation of the reference interval were not supplied.
Not used in the recurrence model.

definition_and_use: Supplied binary indicator, used as a clinical predictor.
unavailable_or_qualification: Detailed pathology assessment criteria were not supplied.

source: Original clinical table; clinical workbook: postop chemo (1 = at least three cycles)
definition_and_use: Adjuvant chemotherapy for at least three cycles: fluoropyrimidine 17, FOLFOX 18, CAPOX 9; 43 patients were recorded as No in the original clinical table.
unavailable_or_qualification: Regimen counts were taken from the original clinical table. Patient-level treatment descriptions in the workbook were not standardized, and exact cycle counts were not supplied. Postoperative treatment was not a predictor.
